newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston equity unit opens LatAm offices.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston equity unit opens LatAm offices.

text.p: BancBoston Capital, the private equity arm of BankBoston Corp, has opened its first offices in Latin America, the company said Tuesday.
BancBoston said in a statement it had opened an office in Buenos Aires, Argentina, for South America's Southern Cone and Andean region, and in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

"Under the leadership of our expanded and now in-region private equity team, we plan to leverage BankBoston's extensive network to tap into a proprietary deal flow and to attract corporate partners or co-investment opportunities," said Rick Fritz, president of BancBoston Capital.
"Last year BBC committed $20 million in Latin America and over the next three years we plan to invest between $100 million and $150 million in private companies in the region."
